☑️ आवेदन चल रहा है |

UP Anganwadi Worker / Helper Online Form 2026 - Updated

  • Last Date : August 2026
  • Eligibility : 12th Pass

District

Bhadohi & Pratapgarh, Varanasi, Chandauli, Shravasti, Siddharth Nagar, Sambhal, Deoria, Mainpuri, Shahjahanpur, Sultanpur, Barabanki, Raebareli, Ghaziabad, Unnao, Ayodhya, Bhadoi, Lakhimpur Khiri (and other districts as per latest notices).

Applications are district-wise on official portals. Candidates must meet residence and educational criteria of the concerned Anganwadi centre area. Keep checking district WCD notices for exact start/last dates and merit lists.

How to Apply

  1. Open official UP WCD / district Anganwadi recruitment portal
  2. Select district and post (Worker / Helper)
  3. Register, fill form, upload documents
  4. Submit and keep printout
